intro: The Signed Recruitment Letter is an official dispatch issued by Kargal Battlescar at the Far Watch Post. Bearing Kargal's mark, it transfers new recruits deeper into the arid interior of the Barrens to report for duty at the Crossroads.

p: Standing as the eastern threshold of the Barrens, the Far Watch Post evaluates newcomers crossing over the Southfury River from Durotar. Once a conscript proves their readiness to Kargal Battlescar, he stamps and signs this letter of introduction. It serves as military orders directing recruits west down the road to the Crossroads, where Sergra Darkthorn coordinates logistical operations and territorial defense across the dry plains.

While the letter is an official document of the Horde, Kargal does not hide his personal contempt for the officer awaiting the recruit. He views Sergra Darkthorn as an abrasive shaman who talks circles around soldiers, openly questioning Warchief Thrall's high opinion of her. Despite his misgivings, the dispatch must be delivered directly into Sergra's hands before any further assignments in the Crossroads are granted.
